html.<b class=\"cM\">Microbes</b> : gardent l: Microbes: guard the VPWR input, the power supply, on the left side of the chip.
html.<b class=\"cD\">Défenseurs</b> : gardent: Defenders: guard the uo_out[0] output, LEDS_LINE, which drives the LEDs, on the top edge.
html.Touche le signal de la broche adverse po: Touch the enemy pin's signal to steal it, bring it back to your pin while yours is in place: 1 capture. 3 captures win the round (8 min max).
Carrier down: the signal drops to the ground. A teammate puts it back by touching it, otherwise it returns on its own after 20 s. No jetpack while carrying the signal; you respawn 5 s after being eliminated.
html.Match à mort par équipe. Chaque éliminat: Team deathmatch. Each elimination increments your team's 4-bit counter, shown in binary.
html.Le premier compteur qui déborde, de 1111: The first counter to overflow, from 1111 to 1 0000, that is 16 eliminations, wins the round (10 min max).
You respawn 4 s after being eliminated. The current counts too: an electrocuted player gives the enemy a point.
html.Trois vraies <b>bascules D</b> (dfxtp) d: Three real D flip-flops (dfxtp) from LEDs Racer are the points to hold: A, B and C.
html.À chaque front d'horloge (1 s), si ton é: On every clock edge (1 s), if your team is alone in the zone, the flip-flop moves one step: on the 3<sup>rd</sup> edge, Q takes your team's value.
html.Chaque front, chaque bascule tenue rappo: On every edge, each flip-flop held scores 1 point. 150 points win the round (8 min max). Respawn in 4 s.
html.Tout le monde commence <b class=\"cD\">D: Everyone starts as a Defender, except one random patient zero.
html.Un défenseur éliminé est contaminé : il: An eliminated defender is infected: they respawn as a Microbe 3 s later. Microbes are faster and twice as tough, but only have their acid at 2.5 µm.
html.Les Défenseurs gagnent si l'un d'eux tie: The Defenders win if one of them holds out for 3 minutes; the Microbes if they infect the whole chip. Team choice is ignored in this mode.
html.<b class=\"cM\">Microbes</b> : déposer l: Microbes: plant the corrosion for 6 s on site A (clock root) or B (power driver), or destroy enough walls.
html.<b class=\"cD\">Défenseurs</b> : les éli: Defenders: eliminate them, neutralize the corrosion in 5 s, repair the chip with right-click.
html.Toutes les 5 à 10 min, la puce est mise: Every 5 to 10 min, the chip is powered on: 15 s of warning, then the metal electrocutes for 20 s.
html.Pour jouer à plusieurs, invite tes amis: To play together, invite your friends from the page's Share menu: they must be signed in to claude.ai.
html.Tu mesures un demi-micron. Le sol est le: You are half a micron tall. The floor is silicon, the red low walls are polysilicon gates, and above them the metal layers stack up to the golden met4 power rails.
html.Explore librement la puce LEDs Racer (<b: Freely explore the LEDs Racer chip (1 361 logic cells, 161 × 226 µm) and find on foot the 234 D flip-flops that hold the game state.
html.Les Microbes attaquent la puce, les Défe: The Microbes attack the chip, the Defenders protect it. A round is won by planting or neutralizing the corrosion, by eliminating the other team, or, for the Microbes, by destroying enough walls. The Defenders see through walls where the Microbes are attacking.
html.Chaque équipe garde une vraie broche de: Each team guards a real pin of the chip: the VPWR power input for the Microbes, the uo_out[0] output (LEDS_LINE) for the Defenders. Steal the enemy signal, bring it back to your pin: three captures win the round.
html.<b>Débordement</b> : match à mort par éq: Overflow: team deathmatch, each elimination increments a 4-bit counter; the first one to overflow wins. D Flip-Flops: hold the chip's three dfxtp flip-flops, they flip on the clock edge and score points. Contamination: a patient zero infects the defenders, who must hold out for 3 minutes.

html.Chaque joueur reçoit un <b>Électron</b>: Each player gets an Electron on the starting grid, in front of the ui_in inputs. Everyone starts on the same signal.
html.Passe les arches dans l'ordre jusqu'à la: Pass the arches in order up to the uo_out[0] output: the track runs along the ground, on the met1 rails then on the golden met4 rails. You change level only in the shafts (green columns).
html.Hors d'un puits, si tu quittes le métal: Outside a shaft, if you leave the metal you fall to the level below and carry on from there. No shooting during the race. First to the output wins (4 min max).
html.Un Électron chacun, départ groupé devant: One Electron each, a mass start in front of the ui_in inputs, finish at the uo_out[0] output. Arches are passed in order, on the ground then on the met1 and met4 rails. You change level in the shafts; leaving the metal drops you one level.
html.Six nano-capsules attendent dans les gar: Six nano-capsules wait in the garages (except in Contamination). Defenders: the BUS Shuttle, 3 seats and an 8-shot turret, and the CAPA, an armored capacitor with a charged shot. Microbes: the Spore, an acid glider, and the Phage, with its injection shot. For everyone: two very fast Electrons that leap forward by tunnel effect (Shift), and the Via Lift that rises from silicon to met4. All vehicles hover between two layers. F to get in or out, left click for the vehicle's weapon; passengers fire their own weapon. Vehicles change level only in the shafts, the green columns: Space to go up, C to go down. A destroyed vehicle throws out its occupants and returns to the garage 45 s later.

html.Chaque arme existe en deux versions de m: Every weapon comes in two versions of equal power: a device for the Defenders, a living organ for the Microbes. They are scattered at random across the chip, in new places every round. Walk over one to pick it up, X or the mouse wheel to switch, right click for the scope. It is lost when empty or when you are eliminated, and respawns 35 s later.
html.À chaque manche, 15 armes sont posées au: Each round, 15 weapons are placed at random on the chip (coloured columns, dots on the map): 405 nm Laser, Electron rifle, EMP cannon, ESD discharge, 1 GHz machine gun, Gamma ray, Photon launcher, Tesla coil, NAND grenade, Ion beam, Short circuit, X-ray bomb, Plasma cannon, PN disintegrator and SQUID rifle. At the same spots, Microbes pick up their organic version, of equal power: Spore spitter, Pilus harpoon, Toxin flower, Enzyme spray, Virion gatling, Lysozyme worm, Triple spore, Flagellum whip, Exploding cyst, Prion dart, Phage pistol, Pandemic, Biofilm blob, Acid gland and Toxin blowpipe. Walk over one to pick it up: its shots are limited, and you lose it when you are eliminated. It comes back 35 s later. Around the contested zones (sites, pins, flip-flops), guard rings act as fortifications: low walls to go around, hide behind and fly over with the jetpack.

html.Et ce n'est pas la seule : avec « Choisi: And it's not the only one: with “Choose your chip”, explore 3610 tiles across 23 Tiny Tapeout chips, from TT 3.5 to IHP 26b, made from 2023 to 2026 in three foundries: SkyWater (SKY130 process, USA), IHP (SG13G2 process, Germany) and GlobalFoundries (GF180MCU process, USA). Every project becomes an arena.
html.Chaque muret, chaque rail doré, chaque v: Every low wall, every golden rail, every via is a real rectangle of the layout: the polysilicon of the gates, the metal layers (li1 to met4 at SkyWater, Metal1 to Metal5 at IHP, Metal1 to Metal4 at GlobalFoundries), the power rails, the D flip-flops that hold the game state.
html.<b>Choisis ta puce</b> affiche toutes le: Choose your chip shows every Tiny Tapeout chip, in the order they were made. Click a chip to open its MUX: the real floorplan of the chip, with its projects laid out around the multiplexer that selects them. Double-click a tile (or click it, then “Choose”): it loads when your next game starts, without reloading the page. Large projects load whole; the microscope (set in the lobby) limits the arena to part of the chip, behind an impassable shield, so that players run into each other. The chosen chip applies to solo play and to the games you create; joining a game on another tile reloads the page.

Scanner : un faisceau balaie une couche: Scanner: a beam sweeps one layer and reveals whoever is on it
<p><b>Scanner</b> : à intervalles réguli: Scanner: at regular intervals, a red beam sweeps one floor of the chip (the ground, li1, met1… met4) and reveals everyone on it to the other team: a red diamond marks them through walls and on the map. Only players on the targeted floor see the countdown, 5 s before the sweep: time to climb or drop. The layer stays swept for 10 s: no quick in-and-out. One sweep every 30 s; both durations are set when creating the game, where the scanner can also be turned off. Above the map, the layer stack shows yours and the one being swept. No scanner in races.
scanner de poche (solo) : colore les cel: pocket scanner (solo): colours the cells by code module; aim at a cell and click to see its role, its transistors and the source code line that created it
